questions.question: In his prayer to God, what did the prophet Jeremiah say God made by His great power and outstretched arm?
God told Jeremiah that the Chaldeans fighting against Jerusalem would come in. What would they do to the city?

answers.text: Set it on fire and burn it
Leave it standing and go home

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, God spoke about the people He had banished in His anger. What did He say He would surely do with them?

answers.text: Gather them from all the lands
Leave them in Babylon for good
